item.text: The parent’s checks accepted files with no melody events. I’ll require nonempty recognized melody and independent parsing, and investigate a local Audiveris installation after the package-manager permission failure.

{"tool":"run","argument":"mkdir -p /workspace/vendor /workspace/deps /workspace/diagnostics
cp -n main.py parent.py
sed -n '1,135p' parent.py
id
command -v java || true
command -v tesseract || true
command -v dpkg-deb || true
python -m pip install --target /workspace/vendor music21 pillow pytesseract requests > diagnostics/pip.log 2>&1
 tail -n 5 diagnostics/pip.log
python - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,json,platform
print('PLATFORM',platform.machine())
u='https://api.github.com/repos/Audiveris/audiveris/releases/latest'
try:
 d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=25))
 open('diagnostics/audiveris-release.json','w').write(json.dumps(d,indent=2))
 print('RELEASE',d['tag_name'])
 for a in d['assets']: print(a['name'],a['browser_download_url'])
except Exception as e: print(type(e).__name__,str(e))
PY","why":"Inspect the exact inherited OCR thresholds, install Python recognition/conversion dependencies locally, and identify a downloadable Audiveris distribution without relying on privileged apt installation."}
